name: Combustion en Feu
description: Porté par la mémoire des mondes disparus, Combustion en Feu explose de chaleur dévastatrice, manie le pouvoir de la radiation, force de frappe de ↑6, arme une lame enflammée.

loadout.armor_outfit: Tattered anti‑radiation shroud stitched with rusted metal plates, asymmetrical shoulder guards exposing swollen tumorous flesh, gauntlets fused with glowing radioactive tubes.
loadout.arsenal: High‑tech plasma flame‑thrower relic (smooth, luminescent violet‑blue energy core), wrist‑mounted antimatter incendiary launcher, chain‑linked fire‑bomb pendants.

attitude.behavior: Raising both mutated arms in a synchronized gesture, directing streams of fire that cascade in perfect unison across the battlefield, moving with a heavy, uneven gait while ash swirls around the boots.
attitude.emotion: Manic, blazing fervor; eyes glowing with radioactive yellow intensity, a grin of scorched teeth showing absolute confidence in destructive coordination.

palette_names.name: Sickly Flesh
palette_names.role: Primary body tone, exposed tumorous skin

palette_names.name: Radioactive Yellow
palette_names.role: Accent glow on tumors, eyes, and energy

palette_names.name: Violet‑Blue Plasma
palette_names.role: High‑tech relic energy, sleek weapon cores

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic rim light with intense orange fire glow, subtle blue‑violet under‑lighting from relic energy, volumetric ash haze

scenography.setting: Scorched post‑apocalyptic wasteland battlefield, cracked earth littered with burning wreckage, distant ruined megastructures silhouetted against a dark, ash‑filled sky
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Flames licking the ground, embers swirling, heat distortion, faint radioactive mist, occasional sparks from the relic weapons
